IMG-D1.question: Q1 how a changed file is noticed
IMG-D1.text: KBOOL_IMAGE_CHECK=stat|dates|hash; default dates (+ KBOOL_VERSION in the key) on Git-bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin (OSTYPE msys* / cygwin*), stat on Linux / macOS / FreeBSD; unset, empty or an invalid value -> the default + one debug line (VERBOSE_KKLASS=debug); a mode whose tool is missing runs as dates; the effective mode is a key row and in the file-name hash. KBOOL_VERSION: declare -g in kbool.sh (not exported), bumped with the CHANGELOG heading by a 'Releasing' step in the kbool root CONTRIBUTING.md; a kbool master test asserts it equals the newest '## X.Y.Z' heading of CHANGELOG.md

IMG-D2.question: Q2 one image per script or chained
IMG-D2.text: KBOOL_IMAGE_CHAIN=on|off, default on (invalid -> on + a debug line). The prior set P (non-system units complete when kk.image starts, in load order from the new kkore list __KK_UNIT_ORDER, with normalised files) joins the key and the file name; P's files are stamped. The image holds only this call's delta; pre-existing slots it changes (kkore tables, P's kklass tables and registries) are element deltas with their earlier values in a base list. A start runs the base check (every base slot holds its recorded earlier value) before sourcing; a failure -> plain kk.uses, no write. With P the writer's simulated start runs in a fresh process (kbool.sh, kk.uses P, the image, hooks) and is compared with the writer's state. The undo also restores the base slots. Holds and pruning per (request, P, mode); caps 8 per (request, P), 16 per request, 64 images / 256 MB per folder. Documented limit: the base check sees written slots, not what the load read from P (R13). KBOOL_IMAGE_CHAIN=off = rev 2's first-load-only rule

IMG-D3.question: Q3 messages
IMG-D3.text: silent for cannot-write, holds, refusals and stale images; one WARNING (once per process) when an existing image file fails a trust check; debug lines for every reason

IMG-D4.question: Q4 location
IMG-D4.text: per-user: XDG_CACHE_HOME / HOME/.cache on POSIX; on Git-bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin LOCALAPPDATA -> USERPROFILE/AppData/Local (same per-user folder) -> HOME/.cache fallback; KBOOL_IMAGE_DIR overrides (the only place for EUID 0). Risk kept visible (plan 8.2, R14): MSYS2 / Cygwin HOME lies inside the install folder; mitigations that keep the choice: the USERPROFILE step, umask 077, a debug line naming the fallback and 'inside the install folder', README advice for shared machines

IMG-D6.question: Q6 internal reload guards
IMG-D6.text: the 88 internal __ self-defaults and X+=() arrays stay at load, image-held; exported __ names are not settings (documented)

IMG-D7.question: Q7 CR functions
IMG-D7.text: the writer reuses kklass's kk._fn_text_cr (parser probed by eval); rc 1 -> no image; no unit edits

IMG-D8.question: Q8 a damaged image
IMG-D8.text: source under if (errexit off, stderr captured), end mark, undo (units, classes, functions, variables, base slots), normal load; a flipped byte that still parses is not detected

IMG-D9.question: Q9 class bodies on bash 5.1
IMG-D9.text: raw declare -f for every function; on bash < 5.2 no image when a function text holds &> "$
